accessibility.accessibleNameSource: None: a separator is not named.
aria: decorative (default): role="none" on the host, nothing exposed
not decorative: role="separator" on the host; aria-orientation="vertical" only when vertical (horizontal is the implicit value)
semantics are set on the host before the first render (willUpdate)
accessibility.role: separator when decorative is false; none when decorative

antiPatterns.pattern: Separator instead of a heading to start a section
antiPatterns.why: A line has no name for navigation
Screen readers announce each one and add noise

useCases.when: Visual spacing between groups of content
A divider that marks a real section boundary for screen-reader users
Dividing items in a horizontal toolbar or row

anatomy.name: line
anatomy.notes: The drawn line (border color, thickness token).

openQuestions.answer: Yes, default true; decorative="false" exposes the separator.
openQuestions.question: Decorative by default?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes: decorative by default; only meaningful boundaries are exposed.

openQuestions.question: No contrast pair for the line?
openQuestions.recommendation: Correct: the line is a decorative divider, not a graphical object needed to understand content (WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply); border-on-background is 1.2:1; the light line is intentional.

decorative.note: Default true. True removes the separator from the accessibility tree (role none). Set decorative="false" (or the property to false) to expose role separator. Because an attribute cannot default to true in HTML, the value "false" turns it off.

orientation.note: Direction of the line. Horizontal is full width and 1px high; vertical is 1px wide and as high as its container.

contract.summary: A thin line that separates content, horizontal or vertical, decorative or announced as a separator.

# Plan: Separator (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-separator`: `orientation` and `decorative` (default true), role none or separator set on the host before first render. Out of scope: labelled separators (text in the middle).

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/separator/Separator.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/separator/separator.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/separator/Separator.scss` -> `Separator.styles.ts` (generated) |
| 4 | `src/components/separator/Separator.ts`, `index.ts` |

No new semantic tokens.

## Test plan (test-first)
- Default: horizontal, decorative, role none, no separator in the accessibility tree.
- `decorative="false"` and property false: role separator; `aria-orientation` only when vertical.
- Role never wrong during first render; toggling updates the role.
- Horizontal 1px high full width; vertical 1px wide stretching a flex row; color and thickness from tokens.
- Not focusable; axe clean.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
None. Boolean default true is handled with a `"false"` attribute value (documented).

## Open questions (recommendation first)
Both answered in contract.json (decorative by default; no contrast pair).
